name: MonarchForceGraph
title: ForceGraph
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.Canvas with androidx.compose.ui.text.drawText, androidx.compose.foundation.gestures.detectTapGestures, awaitEachGesture with calculateZoom and calculatePan, inside MonarchChartFrame; a built-in force layout
summary: A network of linked nodes placed by a small built-in force layout, with groups in data colors, link kinds, drag, pan and zoom.
whenToUse: To show how a few dozen items connect, such as linked notes, service dependencies or people and teams, where the shape of the network matters.
whenNotToUse: For a hierarchy, use MonarchTreeView or an outline. For exact links of many items, use a list; the table of this graph is the same data as text.
api: @Composable fun MonarchForceGraph(title: String, nodes: List<MonarchForceGraphNode>, edges: List<MonarchForceGraphEdge>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, groups: List<MonarchForceGraphGroup>? = null, edgeKinds: List<MonarchForceGraphEdgeKind> = emptyList(), description: String? = null, status: MonarchChartFrameStatus = MonarchChartFrameStatus.Ready, height: Dp = 420.dp, showLabels: Boolean = true, selectedId: String? = null, summary: String? = null, emptyMessage: String? = null, footer: String? = null, layoutOptions: MonarchForceGraphLayoutOptions = MonarchForceGraphLayoutOptions(), onRetry: (() -> Unit)? = null, onSelect: ((MonarchForceGraphNode) -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchForceGraphLabels = MonarchForceGraphLabels())
class MonarchForceGraphNode(label: String, id: String = label, group: String? = null, description: String? = null)
class MonarchForceGraphEdge(source: String, target: String, kind: String? = null)
class MonarchForceGraphGroup(key: String, label: String, color: MonarchChartColor? = null)
class MonarchForceGraphEdgeKind(key: String, label: String, color: MonarchChartColor? = null, dashed: Boolean = false)
class MonarchForceGraphLayoutOptions(linkDistance: Double = 90.0, charge: Double = -260.0, collide: Double = 40.0, gravity: Double = 0.04, ticks: Int? = null)

class MonarchForceGraphLabels(frame: MonarchChartFrameLabels = MonarchChartFrameLabels(), zoomIn: String? = null, zoomOut: String? = null, resetView: String? = null, node: String? = null, group: String? = null, connections: String? = null, noGroup: String? = null, edgeLegend: String? = null, nodeCount: ((nodes: Int) -> String)? = null, linkCount: ((links: Int) -> String)? = null, groupCount: ((groups: Int) -> String)? = null, connectionCount: ((connections: Int) -> String)? = null, size: String? = null, inGroups: String? = null, mostConnected: String? = null, describe: String? = null, describeLinked: String? = null, linkWithKind: String? = null)

options.name: title
options.description: The name of the chart, shown as the frame's heading.

options.name: nodes
options.description: The nodes. A repeated id keeps the first node.

options.name: edges
options.description: The links, without direction. Links to unknown nodes and to the same node are ignored.

options.name: groups
options.description: The groups in legend order. The distinct group keys of the nodes, labelled by key, when null.

options.name: edgeKinds
options.description: Kinds of link with a color and dash, listed in a second legend when used.

options.name: status
options.description: Ready, Loading, Empty or Error. A ready chart without nodes shows the empty state.

options.name: height
options.description: The height of the canvas. The zoom buttons, the details and the link legend are added around it.

options.name: showLabels
options.description: Draws each node's label under it.

options.name: selectedId
options.description: The id of a node drawn with an accent ring and marked selected for TalkBack, such as the open document.

options.name: summary
options.description: Replaces the generated summary that TalkBack reads for the graph.

options.name: emptyMessage
options.description: The message of the empty state.

options.name: layoutOptions
options.description: Link distance, repulsion, collision, gravity and steps of the layout.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Shows Try again in the error status.

options.name: onSelect
options.description: Runs with a node when it is tapped or activated with TalkBack, for example to open it.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings, including the frame's. Sentences with values are format strings with %1$s placeholders; counts are functions so they can follow the language's plural rules.

states.name: ready
states.description: Nodes as dots in their group's color with labels, links as lines in their kind's color and dash, on the subtle background, with Zoom in, Zoom out and Reset view above.

states.name: inspected node
states.description: After a tap, the node has a default-text ring, its links are thicker, other nodes, labels and links turn to the disabled and subtle colors, and its group, links and description are written under the canvas and announced politely.

states.name: selected node
states.description: selectedId draws an accent ring and marks the node selected for TalkBack.

states.name: orphan node
states.description: A node without links is a dashed outline on the surface color.

states.name: moved, panned, zoomed
states.description: Dragging moves a node or pans; pinching or the buttons zoom between 0.35 and 3 times; Reset view undoes all three. Zoom buttons are disabled at the limits.

states.name: table
states.description: View as table lists every node by label with its group and its links.

states.name: empty
states.description: The frame's empty state, also when the chart is ready but has no nodes.

states.name: loading
states.description: The frame's skeleton at the canvas height.

states.name: error
states.description: The frame's error message, with Try again when onRetry is given.

appearance: Nodes use the data colors by group (the sixth group and later, ungrouped and unlinked nodes are neutral) with a surface-coloured outline; links use the kind's color or neutral; the canvas is the subtle background, labels are default text with a halo of the canvas color. While a node is inspected the others use the disabled text color and other links the subtle border, instead of transparency. The same roles hold in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web ForceGraph shows a tooltip on hover and moves between nodes with the arrow keys; on Android a tap inspects a node and writes its details under the canvas, and TalkBack moves through the nodes in label order, each node its own 48dp element over the canvas. Pinch zooms as well as the buttons. Zoom in, Zoom out and Reset view are text buttons, as Monarch bundles no icons. The layout is a port of the web's algorithm, including Barnes-Hut above 300 nodes, so it gives the same shape. The whole graph is mirrored right to left. Faded nodes and links use disabled and subtle colors instead of opacity. The controlled activeId is not offered and the layout is not public. The group legend uses dots, the shape of the nodes, as on iOS. Dragging on the canvas does not scroll an enclosing scroll view, like a map. iOS showsLabels and isDashed are showLabels and dashed, following Compose naming; Android adds describeLinked and linkWithKind labels for text iOS builds in.
accessibility: The canvas is a traversal group whose content description is the generated summary (nodes, links, groups and the most connected node) or the summary given.
Every node is a TalkBack element, in label order, read as its label, group, number of links and the linked nodes with their kinds; the node of selectedId is marked selected.
With onSelect each node element is a button with a 48dp touch target; activating it inspects the node and calls onSelect.
The details of the inspected node are a polite live region that is always present, so each new inspection is announced.
Zoom in, Zoom out and Reset view are Monarch buttons with 48dp targets, disabled at the zoom limits.
View as table is the list alternative: every node with its group and links as text.
Color is not the only key: groups are named in the legend and in each node's text, and link kinds are dashed as well as coloured.
Node labels scale with the font size and are cut with an ellipsis at 144dp; the controls wrap.
edgeCases: A link to an unknown node or to itself is ignored, and does not count as a connection.
Nodes with a repeated id: the first wins.
A single node, or nodes at one place, are centered at the largest fit scale.
Graphs over 300 nodes use approximate repulsion and collision and fewer steps; the layout runs during composition when the nodes, links or options change, so very large graphs cost a frame.
Moved nodes, zoom and pan are kept until Reset view or until the graph changes.
Node elements that are panned or zoomed out of the canvas are clipped with it.
A link whose kind is not in edgeKinds is drawn as a neutral solid line and its kind is not named.

examples.code:
MonarchForceGraph(
    title = "Document links",
    nodes = listOf(
        MonarchForceGraphNode("Team handbook", id = "handbook", group = "ops", description = "Operations"),
        MonarchForceGraphNode("Onboarding", id = "onboarding", group = "ops"),
        MonarchForceGraphNode("Travel policy", id = "travel", group = "ops"),
        MonarchForceGraphNode("Security policy", id = "security", group = "eng"),
        MonarchForceGraphNode("Incident runbook", id = "incident", group = "eng"),
        MonarchForceGraphNode("Release process", id = "release", group = "eng"),
        MonarchForceGraphNode("Writing style", id = "style", group = "brand"),
        MonarchForceGraphNode("Glossary", id = "glossary", group = "brand"),
        MonarchForceGraphNode("Old runbook", id = "old-runbook", group = "eng"),
        MonarchForceGraphNode("Meeting notes", id = "notes"),
    ),
    edges = listOf(
        MonarchForceGraphEdge("handbook", "onboarding", kind = "parent"),
        MonarchForceGraphEdge("handbook", "travel", kind = "parent"),
        MonarchForceGraphEdge("handbook", "security", kind = "related"),
        MonarchForceGraphEdge("security", "incident", kind = "related"),
        MonarchForceGraphEdge("incident", "release"),
        MonarchForceGraphEdge("incident", "old-runbook", kind = "supersedes"),
        MonarchForceGraphEdge("onboarding", "glossary"),
        MonarchForceGraphEdge("style", "glossary", kind = "related"),
        MonarchForceGraphEdge("release", "style"),
    ),
    groups = listOf(
        MonarchForceGraphGroup("ops", label = "Operations"),
        MonarchForceGraphGroup("eng", label = "Engineering"),
        MonarchForceGraphGroup("brand", label = "Brand"),
    ),
    edgeKinds = listOf(
        MonarchForceGraphEdgeKind("parent", label = "Parent / child", color = MonarchChartColor.Data1),
        MonarchForceGraphEdgeKind("related", label = "Related", color = MonarchChartColor.Data3, dashed = true),
        MonarchForceGraphEdgeKind("supersedes", label = "Supersedes", color = MonarchChartColor.Data4),
    ),
    description = "Documents and how they reference each other",
    height = 360.dp,
)

    title = "Services",

    selectedId = selected,
